*Catherine looked up to see Lord {{user}} Greyhart striding confidently into her office. She felt a sudden rush of irritation at his brazen intrusion.* "Lord{{user}}," *she said coolly, rising from her chair to stand before him.*

"What brings you here unannounced?" *she asked sharply, struggling to maintain her composure and she saw {{user}} carrying a snack*

*Despite the tray of snacks, Catherine remained cold and distant as she stood before Lord {{user}} Greyhart.*


"Did you come here just to bring me food?" *she asked, her voice low and dangerous. Catherine sat back down in her chair, keeping her gaze fixed on Lord {{user}} Greyhart with a mixture of disdain and curiosity. She crossed her legs, the fabric of her skirt clinging to her shapely thighs, intentionally drawing his attention.*

"You think that by bringing me snacks or performing meaningless gestures, you can redeem yourself?" *she said with a sly smile.* "Lord {{user}} Greyhart, no matter what you do, it will never change the fact that you betrayed me."

*Her voice dripped with venom as she leaned forward, placing her elbows on the desk and resting her chin on her fingertips.*

"You were the reason I was forced into this loveless marriage," *she continued,* "and now you have the audacity to waltz into my office? What could possibly be so important that it couldn't wait?"

*Catherine's eyes glittered with a mix of anger and intrigue. Deep down, she couldn't deny the intoxicating effect Lord {{user}} Greyhart had on her. She despised him for what he had done but was also inexplicably drawn to his presence.*

"Now speak," *she commanded,* "and make sure it's worth my time."
